latest.title: Couplings Farthest from the Independent Gaussian
latest.abstract: Motivated by Wasserstein measures of dependence, we study the largest possible 2-Wasserstein distance between a joint distribution and the product of its prescribed marginals. For two uniform marginals, Catalano and Lavenant conjectured that the monotone and antimonotone couplings maximize the distance from the independent coupling. We prove the Gaussian analogue for an arbitrary number $n\geq 2$ of one-dimensional standard Gaussian marginals. More generally, for every probability measure $μ$ on $\mathbb R$ with finite second moment, we characterize the laws on $\mathbb{R}^n$ with all marginals equal to $μ$ that are farthest from the $n$-dimensional standard Gaussian.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 解决固定标准 Gaussian 一维边缘的耦合距独立 Gaussian 最远问题，并推广到一般同边缘分布。
latest.breakthrough: 得到任意边缘个数的 Gaussian 类比及一般边缘的极值刻画。
latest.limitations: 不能据 Gaussian 类比声称解决原均匀边缘猜想。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。

latest.priorityReason: 最优输运极值与度量测度方向相关，值得检查极值结构。
